theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (w : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (c σ ρ R A : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → 0 < c → c * ρ < R → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |w x| ≤ A) → Continuous χ → (∀ t, c < t → χ t = 0) → ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x, w x * (-(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * χ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ)) ∂μ) / τ ^ k = ∫ x, w x * (∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * χ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) / τ ^ k) ∂μ
